specification.objective: Fix the admin employee punch tab's desktop layout failure caused by the shared ElevatedButton minimumSize Size.fromHeight(52) giving infinite minimum width when the header action is laid out as a non-flex child of a Row. Keep the global theme and unrelated behavior unchanged.

requirements.statement: Constrain only the 'Novo ponto' ElevatedButton.icon in the desktop punch-section header with a finite local minimum width while preserving the 52px minimum height.
At a 1280x800 desktop viewport, opening the employee 'Ponto' tab keeps its heading readable on a normal horizontal line and produces no Flutter rendering exception.
Leave the shared AppTheme button themes, employee/punch controller behavior, API requests, and other screens unchanged.
Add focused widget regression coverage for the 1280x800 desktop layout and the punch-tab interaction.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The header's 'Novo ponto' ElevatedButton.icon overrides the infinite theme minimum width locally with Size(0, 52), retaining the global theme unchanged.
The focused 1280x800 widget test taps 'Ponto', asserts the 'Gestão de ponto' heading width is greater than 80 logical pixels, and observes no rendering exception.
No backend, API/controller, dependency, shared-theme, or unrelated UI files change.

invariants.statement: The app-wide ElevatedButtonTheme retains minimumSize Size.fromHeight(52).
The employee punch data loading, pagination, and manual edit/create actions retain their existing behavior.

forbidden_states.statement: The desktop punch header action inherits an infinite minimum width while remaining a non-flex Row child, causing the title to collapse into one-character lines.
The fix changes the shared AppTheme or assigns an arbitrary fixed width to the header action.
The fix changes controller/API behavior, dependencies, or unrelated components.

inputs.statement: Flutter Web reproduction at 1280x800: selecting the employee Ponto tab makes the punch-section heading wrap one character per line and stretches the page.
AppTheme configures ElevatedButtonTheme.minimumSize as Size.fromHeight(52), whose width is infinite; the punch header places ElevatedButton.icon beside an Expanded text column in a Row.

outputs.statement: A readable, finite-width punch header with preserved 52px button height.
A regression test that fails on the current collapsed heading and passes after the local width constraint is applied.

failure_semantics.statement: If the heading width is 80 logical pixels or less after opening the Ponto tab, the regression fails with admin_punch_header_title_width_collapsed.

argv: from pathlib import Path; import sys; page=Path('frontend/lib/features/admin/presentation/admin_employees_page.dart').read_text(); test=Path('frontend/test/admin_employees_page_test.dart').read_text(); theme=Path('frontend/lib/theme/app_theme.dart').read_text(); ok='minimumSize: const Size(0, 52)' in page and 'admin_punch_header_title_width_collapsed' in test and 'minimumSize: const Size.fromHeight(52)' in theme; print('admin_punch_layout_ok' if ok else 'admin_punch_layout_incomplete'); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
